summary.text: Louise Stutes, a Republican, has represented District 5 (Kodiak) in the Alaska House of Representatives since 2015.

paragraphs.text: According to the legislative biography, Stutes has lived in Kodiak since 1980 and is a retired business owner who owned the Village Bar for 25 years.
Stutes served on the Kodiak Island Borough Assembly from 2006 to 2013 and chaired the House Fisheries Committee from 2015 to 2020.
